registry_info.description: The Primitives' forms recognised as things: association(config(form)) - the associated object a hall stands beside the form where it is first met, and the tape that writes the association (Palle, 2026-11-03).

mod_fire_extinguisher.name: Fire extinguisher / association(config(cylinder))
mod_fire_extinguisher.description: fire_extinguisher = association(config(cylinder)): the cylinder of Primitives_Columns, configured (red, a valve, a handle, a hose, a label band) and recognised as a thing. A term of the modular class system (commons/modular/terms.json), built from its parent at ready; a grabbable body with a cylinder collider, so it stands, is carried, and rolls.

association_tape.name: Association tape
association_tape.description: A strip of printed tape laid on the floor or a wall, printed with one association: e.g. fire_extinguisher = association(config(cylinder)). Authored, so a hall carries its own sentence; ink, never a step. Config: text, mount floor|wall, ink.

invariant_tape.name: Invariant tape / the cube's own ruler
invariant_tape.description: A printed-tape strip pinned edge to edge across the top of a Trans_Pre cube, in the cube's own frame (scale included), reprinting its length, its ratio to the length it was laid at, and its heading. Moved or turned it reads x1.00; scaled it changes as you watch. config: target (the cube's artifact id).

association_plinth.name: Association plinth / pick it up: into your inventory
association_plinth.description: A solid plinth at reach height under an association example (fire_extinguisher = association(config(cylinder)) ...). Picking the example up collects its inventory item: it goes on the hand's belt (left stick click chooses) and into the hand as a miniature; the example returns to the plinth. config: item, holds (the example's id), top, size [x, z], label.

traffic_cone.name: Traffic cone / plain, banded, post
traffic_cone.description: A traffic cone family (Palle, 2026-11-04, two pictures): an orange frustum with a flat tip and no, one or two white bands on a square or round plate, or a tall delineator post banded near its top. One shared vertex-coloured mesh per setting; solid (static) or a pickable frozen until taken. config: style plain|band|bands|post, height, base square|round|none, wear 0..1, body static|pickable.

cone_stands.name: Cone stands / a cone under every array cube
cone_stands.description: Finds the pick-up cubes of the named arrays on its floor and stands a solid traffic cone under each, the cube seated on its tip (bob stopped, spin kept); the cones stay when a cube is collected. config: targets (artifact ids), height, style, base.
